Changelog#

Notable changes to WELD, newest first.

Unreleased#

  • Version mentions refreshed: ADVISOR ^0.3, Squire kit 0.10.5, lock moved to current tags.
  • Docs: the front page's weld log and cast name each part's latest tag, checked on November 10, 2026: CREED 0.1.9, PROCTOR 0.11.2, Pinstripe 0.3.1, HELMET 1.3.1, SESAME 0.7.3, Sourdough 0.4.2, Squire 0.10.5, Booster 1.17.0, Rollcall 1.1.1, Drawbridge 0.6.1 and ADVISOR 0.3.0. Where WELD locks a part (CREED, PROCTOR, Pinstripe, HELMET, SESAME, ADVISOR), the lock is that same version. Content only; the sheet's design and motion are unchanged.

0.2.1 (2026-11-09)#

  • Fixed: bin/weld.ps1 down and bin/weld.sh down clear public/hot. Vite's dev server writes it so pages load their scripts from http://localhost:5173, and stopping its container left it behind, so the first real run of "Run it like Citadel" served WELD through Parity as a blank page. tests/Unit/LocalStackTest.php fails if either script stops clearing it.
  • Docs: "Run it like Citadel" (README and the quick start) was run word for word on Parity 0.1.0 with Citadel's own citadel/php-apache:8.5r3, and now says what it takes: one health_check line in parity.json that asks Laravel's /up, as Squire's health.php does on Citadel, because Parity's default asks the front page and the front page needs the sessions table the migration makes (without it the first parity up waited five minutes and failed); on a fresh database the first parity up ends on the front page's 500 (on Windows its proxy step can time out on it) until the migration runs; and a folder on the Windows disk is slow inside the container (about 10 seconds a page). Parity 0.1.0 is out, so the docs and the front page's weld log and cast card say 0.1.0 (they said 0.1.0-rc.2) and point at its release on git.wayne.edu until its site is up. The commands reference says what down now clears.
  • Docs: Which command when stops saying squire doctor checks "the local parity setup": the parity kit is deprecated, and local runs on Citadel's image are Parity's job (parity check). The other READMEs copy the row next.

0.2.0 (2026-11-09)#

  • Docs: Parity joins the party. Parity runs Citadel on your own computer (Citadel's PHP image, its proxy and MySQL 5.6) as one program for Windows, macOS and Linux, on Podman or Docker; it takes over local runs from the parity kit in Squire. The README and the quick start gain "Run it like Citadel": build the front end, then parity check, parity init --mysql, parity up, a migration as the citadel user and parity test, with bin/weld.ps1 up, Sail and plain Docker Compose kept as the everyday bench. The README and the Oracle guide add that Citadel's own image carries oci8. The README cast seats Parity next to Squire with its spirit-level mark (fifteen parts now, in the docs overview too). The front page lists it as joint 09 of the weld log (0.1.0-rc.2, Pilot, linked to its repository until its site is up), as Squire's partner under "I'm deploying to Citadel", in a line under "Start here", and as a cast card: the shop floor is now two stacked rows, Booster, Rollcall and ADVISOR, then the Citadel row of Squire, Parity and Drawbridge. Squire's lines stop promising local runs. No app code changes. The bubble sits dead center; the weld is level.

  • Changed: WELD locks SESAME 0.7.2 (was 0.7.1; composer update waynestate/sesame, the constraint stays ^0.7). 0.7.2 fixes docs only: the CAS server's address is https://academica.aws.wayne.edu/cas, not a login.wayne.edu one. No code WELD runs changes.

  • Changed: the regen gate passes against Sourdough's main after it gave its Laravel shapes WELD's Pinstripe extras. The extras themselves (composer lint:gitlab, the composer-ci Code Quality report, the .gitignore line) were already in WELD; the one new path, tests/Unit/PinstripeWiringTest.php, is in the baseline, because WELD's copy records WELD's own Pint excludes (bin/docs-site.php) where Sourdough's records health.php and oracle-check.php.

  • Docs: stale text. The front page's weld log and cast name Sourdough 0.4.0 (Pinstripe 0.3 in every shape) and SESAME 0.7.2, "Running off Citadel" says WELD locks SESAME 0.7.2, and BEST_PRACTICES W26 (with the security guide) and the release guard test name the current Squire kit's release script instead of 0.9.0's.

  • Added: WELD requires Pinstripe 0.3 (waynestate/pinstripe ^0.3 in require-dev), so its coding standard is installed, not copied. phpstan.neon includes vendor/waynestate/pinstripe/phpstan/laravel.neon and keeps only WELD's paths: level 8, the ignore rules and the banned calls (eval(), extract(), var_dump(), dd(), dump(), TLS checks turned off, and SQL joined from strings through DB::select(), PDO, mysqli or oci8) now come from the package. WELD's own code passes the new rules with no new ignore and no baseline (it runs no raw SQL at all, and its one existing ignore is the documented env() read in bootstrap/app.php); a planted DB::select('... ' . $id) and a dd() both fail. pint.json stays as Pinstripe's pint/laravel.json plus two recorded excludes (Squire's deploy/ kit and bin/docs-site.php), because Pint cannot extend another config file and Pinstripe's preset would restyle the vendored kit; tests/Unit/PinstripeWiringTest.php fails if either file drifts from the package. The lock adds spaze/phpstan-disallowed-calls, phpstan/phpstan-strict-rules, phpstan/phpstan-deprecation-rules and nette/neon, and moves PHPStan to 2.3.5. Fitted at last: the suit is off the rack, not run up from a pattern.

  • Added: composer lint:gitlab writes Pint's findings as GitLab Code Quality JSON (Pinstripe's documented setup), and the composer-ci job runs it in after_script, so a style failure shows in the merge request widget. pint-codequality.json is gitignored.

  • Docs: the README, "What is welded in", the status page, MAINTAINING, BEST_PRACTICES W32, the commands reference and the front page say Pinstripe is a dependency. The status page gains "Pinstripe's npm half", the steps for the ESLint and Prettier presets once @waynestate/pinstripe 0.3.0 is on npm (it has 0.1.4 today; the move needs ESLint 10 and one reformat). The front page's weld log stops saying Pinstripe 0.3.0 is on npm.

  • Docs: stale text. The front page's weld log and cast name each part's latest release (Sourdough 0.3.0 with sourdough adopt, Squire 0.10.3, Booster 1.14.0, Rollcall 1.1.0, Drawbridge 0.6.0), the README, "What is welded in", the status page and the front page say Pinstripe 0.3.0 is on Packagist (they said Packagist still listed 0.1.4), BEST_PRACTICES W8 stops calling the portable image Unreleased, and the Unreleased notes drop internal decision IDs.

  • Changed: the deploy kit is Squire 0.10.3 (was 0.10.2), refreshed with squire update --path=deploy: the kit's comments say in plain words what they used to point at with internal item IDs. Comments only; no setting, default or behavior changes, and squire init --check passes.

  • Docs: MAINTAINING's "Who maintains it" names a role, the stack maintainer, instead of a person, and says to reach them with an issue on git.wayne.edu.

  • Docs: Which command when gains a sourdough adopt row (Sourdough 0.3.0: it writes only the manifest, records a file that differs as yours, never overwritten, and exits 1 on a refusal, 2 on a tool error), the sourdough manifest --check row takes 0.3.0's "seeded and yours files are never reported" wording, and the rollcall report row gives its real exit codes, 0, or 2 on a tool error such as no scan yet (it said "Always exit 0"). The README's copy matches; the other READMEs copy it next.

  • Changed: the portability job blocks: its first run on the arm64 runner passed, so allow_failure is gone. Its rules (main and tags, manual on a merge request, never from the schedule), interruptible and the after_script cleanup stay, and tests/Unit/PortabilityJobTest.php fails if allow_failure comes back.

  • Changed: CI pins every Preflight component to 0.5.0 (was 0.4.0). The portability job drops its start_command shim (setsid and a cat pipe), because 0.5.0's probe starts each replica in its own session behind a stdio pipe the uid owns, and the old shim would fail health; it now runs the image's own entrypoint, as the platforms do. composer-audit drops its image: input, since 0.5.0 defaults to composer:2.11.1 by digest. The local a11y scripts and tests/Unit/A11yCheckerPinTest.php name 0.5.0 (the checker did not change). The GitHub workflow stays on Preflight 0.1.4's commit SHA, because the GitHub mirror of Preflight has no 0.5.0 yet.

  • Changed: the deploy layer's PROCTOR job blocks: proctor check in deploy/ passes on PROCTOR 0.11.1 (warnings only), so its allow_failure and the comment naming findings it no longer has are gone.

  • Changed: WELD takes the stack's current releases, matching Sourdough 0.3.0's Inertia bake: HELMET ^1.3 (locked 1.3.0, was ^1.1 at 1.1.0), SESAME ^0.7 (0.7.1, was ^0.6 at 0.6.2), CREED ^0.1.8 (0.1.8, was 0.1.7), PROCTOR ^0.11 (0.11.1, was ^0.9 at 0.9.0) and ADVISOR ^0.2 (0.2.0, was ^0.1 at 0.1.6). The deploy layer takes HELMET ^1.3 (1.3.0), PROCTOR ^0.11 (0.11.1) and CREED ^0.1.8 (0.1.8). MAINTAINING, BEST_PRACTICES W17 and W28 (with the HELMET config lines they cite), the configuration page, Running WELD off Citadel and the front page's weld log and cast name the new versions.

  • Changed: the deploy kit is Squire 0.10.2 (was 0.10.0), refreshed with squire update --path=deploy: the fallback base names its PHP, Node and Composer images in full (docker.io/library/...) and takes Composer 2.11.1 as a COMPOSER_IMAGE build argument, .squire/php.ini sets session.cookie_samesite = Lax, and the portable image drops node_modules/ after the build (SQUIRE_KEEP_NODE_MODULES=1 keeps it). The portability job's setup builds the kit's base as it ships and passes all three images through the Dependency Proxy with docker.io/library/ swapped for the group prefix, as Squire's Image hardening guide shows, instead of rewriting a copy with sed; tests/Unit/PortabilityJobTest.php holds it.

  • Changed: WELD's own CI jobs and the local stack's app service run composer:2.11.1, pinned by its multi-arch list digest (was 2.10.3, which Squire 0.10.1 calls unmaintained); 2.11.1 fixes GHSA-c968-33g3-wh7p and GHSA-fm2w-xgf2-f9fh.

  • Added: Preflight's portability job (0.4.0) builds the portable image with Buildah and boots it twice as a uid with no name in group 0, the way OpenShift, Coolify and plain Docker run it, checking /up for an IP Host, no baked .env or config cache, forged forwarded headers, logs on stderr, writes only in storage/ and bootstrap/cache/, and a clean stop on SIGTERM. WELD's portability: block builds the kit's fallback base in the same job first (from a copy that names the Composer COPY --from image in full, because Buildah refuses a short name there), resets the checkout's modes and makes a fresh APP_KEY, and its start_command runs the image's own entrypoint under setsid and behind a cat pipe, two shims for how Buildah runs a replica (a shared process group, root-owned stdio) that go once Preflight's probe handles them; session-hop waits for a shared database (W15). It runs on main and tags, is manual on a merge request and never runs from the schedule, does not block until its first green run on the runner, is interruptible, and its after_script deletes the containers and images it left in Buildah's storage. tests/Unit/PortabilityJobTest.php holds the job. BEST_PRACTICES W10, W14 and W16 move to Checked, W8, W13 and W17 cite the job, and W12, W15 and W24 say what it leaves out.

  • Added: a feature test proves /up answers 200 for a forged or IP:port Host, sets no cookie and does not redirect (W11).

  • Changed: the deploy kit is Squire 0.10.0 (was 0.9.0): no kit file changed, so the record moves to 0.10.0.

  • Fixed: scripts/a11y.ps1 works on a Windows checkout with CRLF line endings; it strips the carriage returns from the shell command it hands to Docker, which sh rejected with a syntax error.

  • Changed: WELD takes the stack's current releases: HELMET ^1.1 (locked 1.1.0, was 1.0.0), PROCTOR ^0.9 (0.9.0, was 0.8.0), SESAME 0.6.2 (was 0.6.0), CREED 0.1.7 (was 0.1.6) and ADVISOR 0.1.6 (was 0.1.5; 0.1.7 is tagged but not on Packagist yet), and the deploy layer HELMET 1.1.0, PROCTOR 0.9.0 and CREED 0.1.7. WELD calls no helmet_ribbon(), so HELMET's moved function needs no change. php artisan optimize now passes (SESAME 0.6.1 made its routes controller actions), so Running WELD off Citadel drops its SQUIRE_ARTISAN_OPTIMIZE=0 warning; MAINTAINING, BEST_PRACTICES W17 and W28, the configuration page and the front page name the new versions.

  • Docs: the front page gains "The weld log", the stack's hub: all fourteen parts on one inspection sheet, WayneUI as joint 00, each with its latest release (checked 2026-11-09), a one-line state, an inspection stamp (Stable, In use or Pilot) and links to its site and docs; with motion allowed, each joint tacks gold in turn as it scrolls in. The nav and the hero link point at it. The cast cards carry full release numbers and real commands in their terminals, the bench marks Rolodex as paused, and the paths say Inertia 3. README, MAINTAINING, the status page and "What is welded in" list every part that is welded in (ADVISOR, Preflight 0.4.0, Squire's kit 0.9.0; Pinstripe still copied), the CI jobs and checks as they run, and trusted proxies read from TRUSTED_PROXIES. BEST_PRACTICES' intro describes the repo as of 2026-11-09, and its "Unverified" list becomes a "Verified" note saying where each item is pinned (CsrfTest.php:8, W13, composer.json:37, no spatie/laravel-health); a forged Host on /up is still untested, so that half of W11 stays Documented.

  • Changed: the GitLab regen gate runs on every tag, on a pipeline schedule and on Run pipeline, and on a push only when the push touches a path the gate compares or the gate itself, so docs and site pushes no longer turn main red for drift they cannot cause. The job is interruptible, and only its network steps (the two composer install lines and the Sourdough clone) get three tries, so a dropped GitHub download no longer fails it while drift still fails at once. .deploy never runs from a schedule, and tests/Unit/RegenGateRulesTest.php holds the rules. The nightly schedule itself is a project setting, pending the maintainer's approval.

  • Added: deprecations fail the tests, copied from Sourdough's Inertia shape. phpunit.xml sets failOnDeprecation (indirect deprecations, a package's to fix, are ignored), and tests/TestCase.php hands deprecations back to PHPUnit through tests/Support/ReportsDeprecationsToPhpUnit.php, byte for byte from Sourdough, because Laravel's handler drops them while testing. tests/Unit/DeprecationGateTest.php holds the settings; the suite raised none.

  • Changed: the deploy layer runs Squire's kit 0.9.0 (was 0.8.0), refreshed with squire update --path=deploy: a Laravel release now stops when APP_KEY is unset or APP_DEBUG is on in production, before anything installs, and warns on an APP_ENV that is not production (tests/Feature/ReleaseEnvGuardTest.php, BEST_PRACTICES W26); SQUIRE_PHP_RUNTIME picks the PHP version PROCTOR's gate grades. BEST_PRACTICES W10, W22 and W24 cite the moved release-script lines.

  • Changed: the regen gate is IDENTICAL again for scripts/release.sh (RELOCATED under deploy/), tests/TestCase.php, tests/Support/ReportsDeprecationsToPhpUnit.php and Laravel 13's storage/framework ignore files (lsp-*.php, the cache locks/ folder), and the baseline drops those three ignore files.

  • Changed: SESAME's CAS protocol defaults to 2.0, as SESAME does, because WSU's CAS is believed to refuse the cookieless /p3/ validation CAS 3.0 uses; set SESAME_CAS_PROTOCOL=3.0 for a CAS server that answers it.

  • Docs: BEST_PRACTICES W11, W18 and W20 follow the copies. W11 cites /ready in bootstrap/app.php (it pointed at a stale routes/web.php:11) and names the database and cache checks and the test that breaks each; W18 is Checked for the job attributes (#[Backoff] stays open); W20 is Checked for every job, not only the scheduled worker. W9, W23 and W27 cite the bootstrap/app.php lines that moved, and the guides are synced.

  • Added: every queued job carries its limits. tests/Feature/JobLimitsTest.php fails the suite on a queued job under app/Jobs without #[Tries] and #[Timeout], or with a timeout at or above the queue connection's retry_after, and passes while there are no jobs; stubs/job.queued.stub and stubs/job.batched.queued.stub make php artisan make:job write #[Tries(3)] and #[Timeout(45)]. Copied byte for byte from Sourdough's Inertia shape.

  • Added: /ready checks the database and the cache as well as the scheduler heartbeat (app/Health/DatabaseReady.php, app/Health/CacheReady.php), and moves from routes/web.php to the routing then: callback in bootstrap/app.php, outside the web group, so a probe writes no session row and sets no cookie. The checks and tests/Feature/ReadyChecksTest.php (which breaks the database, then the cache, and expects 503) are byte for byte from Sourdough's Inertia shape; the route lines are merged into WELD's own bootstrap/app.php and routes/web.php.

  • Fixed: composer docs:practices skipped the nine practices under ## W25: style headings (Security, Build and supply chain), so those guides went stale: W26 read Not yet while it was Enforced, W27 and W28 Documented while Checked. The sync now reads a colon or a period after the id, rewrote both guides, and both modes fail when a practice has no guide section, has two, lacks its Stack line, or a section names a practice BEST_PRACTICES.md does not have (tests/Unit/PracticesCoverageTest.php). BEST_PRACTICES W31 and W33 keep the facts only their guides carried, and the composer.json line numbers in W6, W9, W25, W30 and W32 are current again.

  • Changed: CI pins the Preflight components to 0.4.0 (the proctor job clones the full history, so the override-approver check can read git blame).

  • Added: PortableImageTest proves the portable image builds vendor/ without dev packages (the build context leaves vendor/ out and its only Composer install is release.sh's --no-dev one), which closes W29's open item.

  • Changed: the regen baseline no longer excuses docker-compose.squire.yml, health.php and scripts/release.sh: Sourdough bakes Squire 0.8.0 now, so a fresh bake matches WELD's kit.

  • Changed: the deploy layer names Squire 0.8.0 (was 0.7.1), the release that ships the portable image WELD already carries; no kit file changed.

  • Changed: the regen gate passes against Sourdough 3000349 with three Squire kit paths accepted in the baseline until Sourdough takes Squire 0.8.0: deploy/docker-compose.squire.yml, deploy/health.php and deploy/scripts/release.sh come from Squire's newer kit (the portable image's compose profile, health.php reading SQUIRE_APP_DIR, the release-script download cache), while Sourdough's templates/squire still carries 0.7.1's. Drop the three from .sourdough/regen-baseline.json once Sourdough's kit catches up; everything else matches Sourdough's Inertia shape or was already accepted.

  • Added: the deploy kit takes Squire's portable image (from Squire's Unreleased kit, ahead of its next tag): deploy/.squire/portable.Dockerfile bakes WELD in and runs as web, worker (queue:work --tries=3 --max-time=3600 --sleep=3), scheduler (schedule:work, with QUEUE_WORKER_MODE=none) or migrate by SQUIRE_ROLE, as USER 10001:0 with group-0 writable storage/ and bootstrap/cache/, Apache on 8080, and a graceful stop on SIGTERM; the compose file's portable profile runs the four from one image. BEST_PRACTICES W8 and W13 move to Checked for the portable path (tests/Feature/PortableImageTest.php, and Squire's own PortableImageTest), and W16 names the portable stop. The Citadel mirror does not change. The kit also brings Squire's release-script download cache (SQUIRE_CACHE_DIR).

  • Docs: Running WELD off Citadel gains the portable image (build, run as an arbitrary UID, the four roles) and a warning that php artisan optimize fails on SESAME 0.6.0's route closures until they move to controllers (SQUIRE_ARTISAN_OPTIMIZE=0 meanwhile); its Citadel queue row names the real switch, QUEUE_WORKER_MODE=scheduler.

  • Added: WORKER_HEARTBEAT_MAX_AGE=0 turns the scheduler heartbeat check off, so an app that runs no scheduler still answers 200 on /ready. app/Health/SchedulerHeartbeat.php, config/worker.php and tests/Feature/SchedulerHeartbeatTest.php are byte for byte from Sourdough's Inertia shape again, .env.example says so next to the setting, and BEST_PRACTICES W23 cites the new test.

  • Added: the CI gates from Sourdough's Inertia shape, job for job (the file's other lines stay WELD's). The a11y-pages job boots WELD with SESAME's fake driver and saves / and /dashboard, signed in. A second a11y include, a11y-app, checks those pages at WCAG 2.2 AA, blocking, beside the site's a11y job. Preflight's sbom keeps sbom.cdx.json, the frontend job adds sbom-npm.cdx.json from CycloneDX's npm tool, and Preflight's secret-detection runs Gitleaks. A hidden .deploy template keeps any future deploy job off merge requests and on protected refs.

  • Changed: config/helmet.php is now a thin override (only policy_path, pointed at the bundled CREED policy), copied byte for byte from Sourdough's Inertia shape. HELMET's service provider merges the package's own config for everything else, so WELD picks up HELMET's newer settings and its Playbook lookup for HELMET_PRESET instead of a 400-line copy that had fallen behind. Laravel merges config one level deep, so an app that changes csp or trusted_types sets that whole key in its config/helmet.php (php artisan vendor:publish --tag=helmet-config --force brings back the full file). The regen baseline is one path shorter (config/helmet.php now matches), and BEST_PRACTICES W28 cites the package's lines.

  • Added: W23, a stopped scheduler shows up at /ready. The scheduler stamps the cache every minute (scheduler-heartbeat in routes/console.php), and HELMET's /ready answers 503 while the stamp is missing or older than WORKER_HEARTBEAT_MAX_AGE (default 180 seconds, config/worker.php). /up stays the liveness answer, and nothing probes /ready yet: Squire's health check still asks /up. Copied byte for byte from Sourdough's Inertia shape, with tests/Feature/SchedulerHeartbeatTest.php; BEST_PRACTICES W23 is Checked for the heartbeat (the Prometheus gauge is still open).

  • Added: the Node floor from Sourdough: .nvmrc (22), engines.node >=22 in package.json, and .npmrc with the one-day min-release-age=1 cooldown, so a package published an hour ago waits a day before it lands in a build.

  • Changed: the regen gate passes against Sourdough's current main again, and the baseline is one path shorter (.npmrc now matches). The joint holds.

  • Added: Laravel Boost ^2.10 in require-dev, copied from Sourdough's Inertia shape: .ai/guidelines/wayne-state.md and .ai/rules/ are committed, the .gitignore keeps out what boost:install writes (boost.json, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .claude/skills/, .junie/; .agents/ stays tracked), and post-update-cmd runs a guarded composer boost-update. tests/Feature/BoostDevOnlyTest.php and a new no-dev-install CI job (GitLab and GitHub) keep Boost out of production. W5 and W29 are Checked; W5 now says to ignore the agent files whole, since git cannot ignore only Boost's block inside them.

  • Added: bin/sync-practices.php writes each practice's Practice, Why and Stack lines in docs/guides from BEST_PRACTICES.md, and composer ci fails when a guide drifts (19 of 24 had).

  • Changed: W20, the scheduled queue worker sets --timeout=45, below the connection's retry_after (Laravel's default 90), and QueueWorkerScheduleTest checks the two; W20 is Checked for that worker. Copied byte for byte from Sourdough's Inertia shape. The queues guide names the real switch, QUEUE_WORKER_MODE=scheduler (it said WELD_QUEUE_MODE=scheduled).

  • Changed: WELD requires SESAME ^0.6 (locked 0.6.0, was ^0.5 and 0.5.0), matching Sourdough's Inertia bake; MAINTAINING.md and five docs pages name the current HELMET 1.0 and Preflight 0.3.1 pins.

  • Changed: the deploy layer runs Squire's kit 0.7.1 (was 0.7.0): .squire/php.ini no longer sets session.sid_length or session.sid_bits_per_character (PHP 8.4 deprecated both), so sessions use PHP's default 128-bit ID.

  • Added: W19, the scheduler runs the queue on Citadel: QUEUE_WORKER_MODE=scheduler (the .env.example default) schedules queue:work --stop-when-empty --max-time=50 --tries=3 every minute; none leaves it to a supervisor. Copied byte for byte from Sourdough 53275fb; QueueWorkerScheduleTest covers both modes. BEST_PRACTICES W19 is Checked.

  • Docs: BEST_PRACTICES Stack lines match the code again: W1, W3, W4, W7, W9, W11, W27 and W28 move to Checked and W26 to Enforced (each names its test), eight rows cite the lines that moved, and the CI header names Preflight 0.3.1.

  • Changed: the deploy kit moves to Squire 0.7.0: the release script restarts queue workers and the scheduler after optimize (reload, or queue:restart and schedule:interrupt), report only, so W22 is Checked. The kit also brings Squire 0.7.0's image hardening: the web's PHP loses exec, passthru, shell_exec, system, pcntl_exec, phpinfo, show_source and highlight_file (the CLI keeps them; SQUIRE_PHP_DISABLE_FUNCTIONS sets the list, none disables nothing), production opcache (SQUIRE_OPCACHE_VALIDATE=1 by default, 0 for an image that bakes its code in), Apache's ServerTokens Prod, and secrets read from /run/secrets. See Squire's upgrading notes for 0.7.0.

  • Changed: the local a11y scripts run Preflight's own checker (vendored from 0.3.1 and pinned by a test), so they check what CI checks: axe-core 4.14.0, 320 and 1280 px, and the reflow check.

  • Added: tests/Feature/SchedulerNamingTest.php fails on any scheduled closure without ->name(), so onOneServer() and withoutOverlapping() always have a lock name (Sourdough's copy, W21).

  • Added: CI runs Preflight's a11y component (0.3.1) on site/, every page in light and dark at 320 and 1280 px with the WCAG 1.4.10 reflow check, blocking.

  • Changed: Inertia 3 (inertiajs/inertia-laravel ^3.0, @inertiajs/vue3 ^3.0), matching Sourdough's Inertia shape: the progress bar gets HELMET's CSP nonce and the title is marked data-inertia (W4).

  • Changed: the composer image in WELD's own CI jobs is pinned by its multi-arch digest, like the Node image already was.

  • Added: tests/Feature/CsrfTest.php proves a POST without a CSRF token gets 419, and that a matching token or a same-origin request passes (Sourdough's copy, W27).

  • Changed: the GitHub regen gate blocks like GitLab's (it only warned), now that the drift baseline is complete.

  • Changed: CI pins the Preflight components to 0.3.1 (fixed cache keys, and caches saved even when a job fails).

  • Changed: CI saves its Composer and npm caches even when a job fails, so a retry after a dropped download fetches only what is missing.

  • Added: the app refuses to boot in production with APP_DEBUG on (app/Support/ProductionDebug.php, Sourdough's guard).

  • Changed: WELD's own CI jobs cache Composer and npm downloads under a fixed key, so a lock change downloads only what changed.

  • Fixed: MAINTAINING.md and BEST_PRACTICES.md name the HELMET 1.0, SESAME 0.5 and Preflight 0.3.0 pins and the composer.json and CI lines they cite today.

  • Changed: HELMET moves to ^1.0, its first stable release, wherever this repo requires it.

  • Fixed: the docs menu closes with Escape and hands focus back to its button (docs kit synced from Squire).

  • Fixed: the docs kit's copy button no longer covers the first line of code when it says Copied or Failed: over the code it keeps its resting width and shows a check or a cross when the word does not fit (docs kit synced from Squire).

  • Fixed: the front page's version chip shows the full version the docs show (0.1.5, was 0.1). It carries data-docs-version now, so the docs builder (synced from Squire) rewrites it at every release and composer docs:check fails while it is stale.

  • Fixed: the Which command when page reads as one ticket per command on a phone (640 px and narrower), each answer under its column's name, instead of a four-column table that scrolled sideways.

  • Changed: the pipeline pins every Preflight CI component to 0.3.0 (preflight@0.3.0); component image inputs are plain image names, since Preflight adds the Dependency Proxy prefix itself.

  • Changed: the app requires PROCTOR ^0.8 in require-dev (was ^0.7, locked 0.8.0), so its CI also runs the new crlf-deploy-script check, and the deploy layer requires PROCTOR ^0.8 (was ^0.4, locked 0.8.0).

  • Docs: a "Which command when" page (Reference) and README section put the look-alike commands side by side (weld:doctor, squire doctor, proctor check, proctor gate, oracle:check and the rest): what each checks, when to run it and where it runs. It is the canonical copy; the READMEs of Squire, PROCTOR, Sourdough, Booster and Rollcall carry it word for word.

0.1.5 (2026-11-07)#

  • Fixed: the committed Ziggy route list (resources/js/ziggy.js and ziggy.d.ts) includes SESAME 0.5's sesame.status route, so the ziggy job is green again.
  • Fixed: composer proctor and ProctorCheckTest run plain proctor check; PROCTOR 0.7 refuses --policy in CI, which turned proctor-root and every php-test job red.
  • Fixed: the pipeline's PROCTOR jobs no longer pass --policy, which PROCTOR 0.7 refuses in CI; PROCTOR checks against the CREED policy it bundles.

0.1.4 (2026-11-07)#

  • Changed: the front page deploy layer (deploy/) runs Squire's kit 0.6.0 (was 0.5.0): scripts/release.sh now asks PROCTOR for a go or no-go right after composer audit, before the front end builds and the migrations run (the verdict lands in proctor-gate.json under SQUIRE_PROCTOR_RECORD_DIR, ratcheted against the last release that went on; SQUIRE_PROCTOR=enforce stops the release on a no-go, the default is report only), and .env.squire.example gains SQUIRE_PROCTOR_RECORD_DIR. The squire holds the gate; the proctor says who may pass.
  • Changed: the GitLab pipeline pins the Preflight components to the 0.2.0 release SHA (was 0.1.4).
  • Changed: the stack pins move up: HELMET ^0.4 (locked 0.4.0), SESAME ^0.5 (locked 0.5.0) and PROCTOR ^0.7 (locked 0.7.0). SESAME 0.5 binds each sign-in to the browser that started it, so config/sesame.php gains require_pending_login (on by default; off only for an app that must accept a ticket for a login it did not start) and the fake driver answers jane.doe when SESAME_FAKE_USERNAME is unset.
  • Added: tests/Feature/SkeletonTest.php, the skeleton tests Sourdough ships with its Inertia template: /up, the guest and signed-in routes, the 404 page, and the resolver's round trip from a JSON session back to the User. WELD's branded Welcome page is asserted where the skeleton shows Home.
  • Changed: the regen baseline rebalances for the 0.6.0 kit: config/sesame.php converges byte for byte, docker-compose.squire.yml and scripts/release.sh sit under deploy/ as relocated copies, and tests/Feature/SkeletonTest.php joins the accepted drift (52 known paths now).
  • Fixed: the front page and the Sourdough guide say Sourdough bakes all five app shapes (they said four, with raw PHP plus a Vue SPA still waiting). "Pick your path" gives that shape its own card (sourdough new my-app --raw --vue), and the WELD card spans the row's last two cells.
  • Fixed: the README, "What is welded in" and the status page name Pinstripe 0.1.4 as the release on Packagist (they said 0.1.1).
  • Changed: the front page's deploy layer (deploy/) runs Squire's kit 0.5.0 (was 0.4.0): .squire/base-fallback.Dockerfile and scripts/parity.ps1 take the new templates, and docker-compose.squire.yml, which Renovate had edited, is Squire's template again, so squire init --check passes.
  • Changed: The canonical repository is git.wayne.edu (ADR-0021); docs, links and package metadata no longer point at the archived nougat copy.
  • Changed: the GitLab regen-gate job blocks: allow_failure is gone, so new drift against Sourdough's main fails the pipeline. Fix the drift here or upstream in Sourdough, or record the current drift as accepted with --write-baseline and commit .sourdough/regen-baseline.json; the GitHub pipeline keeps continue-on-error.
  • Fixed: the README says Sourdough bakes five shapes, including raw PHP with a Vue SPA, which ships; it no longer says that shape is not available yet.
  • Fixed: scripts/a11y.ps1 and its .sh twin mount the repo read-write instead of read-only plus a named volume for tools/a11y/node_modules: Docker Desktop refuses the nested volume, so on Windows the script failed before the container started. node_modules is gitignored, so the tree stays clean and npm still installs once and reuses it.
  • Changed: WELD reconciles with Sourdough main (323a82b). App\Sesame\UserResolver adopts the template's username lookup (the same fix for Laravel 13's JSON sessions as WELD's id lookup; the docblock keeps WELD's name), and the regen baseline records four product drifts (docker-compose.squire.yml, where renovate keeps the haproxy digest newer than the Squire template copy; eslint.config.js; AppHeader.vue; navigation.ts) while dropping 17 paths that converged with the WayneUI-wired template or left it (53 known paths now). The full report of the run against 323a82b sits at .sourdough/regen-report-2026-11-07.txt.
  • Added: an accessibility gate for the site: scripts/a11y.sh (Git Bash, Linux, macOS) and scripts/a11y.ps1 (Windows) run axe-core (WCAG 2.2 AA, light and dark, at 360 px and 1280 px) in Docker over every committed HTML page under site/, so the Proof page's hand-run check is repeatable with one command; the first full run checked all 23 pages with 0 violations.
  • Added: The Proof page records its last run.

0.1.3 (2026-11-06)#

  • Changed: the Proof page marks the 0.1.2 install and the regen drift as fixed.

  • Fixed: every php-test job in the GitLab pipeline (PHP 8.3, 8.4, 8.5) crashed with exit 255 since the move to Pest. Preflight's component runs vendor/bin/phpunit unless told otherwise, and PHPUnit refuses to load a Pest file ("Please run ./vendor/bin/pest instead"); the jobs now run vendor/bin/pest, which runs the PHPUnit class tests too. Sourdough's Laravel templates got the same fix.

  • Fixed: the suite printed 62 warnings in CI, where there is no .env (Pest reports phpdotenv's suppressed read of the missing file). tests/TestCase.php now boots through tests/Support/SkipEnvFile.php, which reads .env when it exists and .env.example otherwise, the same files Sourdough's Inertia template ships.

  • Changed: App\Support\DummyAppKey and its call in AppServiceProvider now come from Sourdough's Laravel templates, so every Sourdough app refuses the dummy test key in production too. The regen gate reports no new drift, and .sourdough/regen-baseline.json shrinks from 87 to 65 known paths (35 files now match Sourdough byte for byte, up from 29).

  • Fixed: the two DummyAppKey tests that only proved "no exception" by not crashing now assert it, so the suite reports no risky tests.

  • Added: a Proof page (Reference, docs/reference/proof.md). On 2026-11-06 a new app was made from an empty folder both documented ways, every gate WELD ships was run locally and timed, an axe-core accessibility gate checked four pages at two widths in light and dark (0 violations), and one small Wayne State app was ported onto a fresh clone. It lists what held, what broke, and what it does not prove.

  • Fixed: the first page after up was blank. The Vite container ran vite --host, so public/hot said http://[::]:5173, which the browser cannot reach; compose.yaml now runs npm run dev with LARAVEL_SAIL: '1', and the plugin writes http://localhost:5173. tests/Unit/LocalStackTest.php holds it.

  • Fixed: on Windows every second bin\weld.ps1 up emptied the local SQLite database (New-Item -Force truncates an existing file). It now creates the file only when it is missing; the same test holds it, and the macOS and Linux script, which uses touch, is pinned too.

  • Changed: Install and the README say that composer create-project installs the newest tag, which can trail main; Troubleshooting covers the blank page, a new page Vite cannot find on Windows (restart Vite), and the emptied database.

  • Changed: the README's note about the Citadel deploy layer moves from above the title into Documentation.

  • Security: the front-page deploy layer moves to Symfony 7.4.23 (symfony/http-foundation and symfony/yaml advisories, including CVE-2026-118514).

  • Changed: dark docs are the shop after hours instead of a green wallpaper: a steel field and steel-plate pages with cream type and gold links, green kept for the helmet and the footer band. The theme now restates every kit dark token, so WayneUI's dark green surface no longer leaks in. Numbered steps sit on gold discs along a dashed seam, as on the front page; each page title lands hot and cools; a pager card runs a bead along its top on hover or focus (motion only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference). Wide tables keep a readable notes column and show a shade at the edge that scrolls.

  • Fixed: on a phone the header (front page and docs) takes two rows, so the version chip no longer rides over the WELD name.

  • Changed: WayneUI draws the app. @waynestate/wayne-ui-css and @waynestate/wayne-ui-vue 2.0.8 are npm dependencies pinned exactly (the lock's sha512 integrity is the checksum), resources/css/app.css imports WayneUI's layered stylesheet, and every page wears its components: the app bar with the shield and the theme toggle, the sidebar that becomes a focus-trapping drawer on phones, breadcrumbs, cards, fields, the delete-account dialog and the footer. The welcome page is new: the WELD wordmark over a gold seam that draws itself once, and the six stops of a request lighting up along it (still and finished with reduced motion). All 14 TODO(wayneui) stand-ins are resolved.

  • Changed: the appearance setting is WayneUI's own theme switch (wsu-theme), so the settings page and the bar's sun and moon button stay in step, a pre-paint script (under HELMET's nonce) stops the dark-mode flash, and an old appearance choice carries over once.

  • Removed: the starter kit's Tailwind theme and its helpers: tailwind.config.js, cn() (resources/js/lib/utils.ts), clsx, tailwind-merge, @headlessui/vue, lucide-vue-next, @vueuse/core, prettier-plugin-tailwindcss, @tailwindcss/forms and the 16 kit components they served.

  • Added: BEST_PRACTICES W2 (WayneUI is the only component source) is Checked. ESLint bans imports from a components/ui path and the kit's helper packages, tests/Feature/WayneUiOnlyTest.php fails on a components.json, a Tailwind dependency or a loose WayneUI pin, and a new frontend CI job (GitLab and GitHub) runs npm ci, lint, Prettier, vue-tsc and the build. Ziggy's client now comes from the ziggy-js npm package, so the front end builds without vendor/.

  • Fixed: Save on the profile page and Delete on the account dialog did nothing in a browser. Laravel's JSON sessions hand SESAME's stored user back as an array, so the profile called the user's own email "already taken" and deletion answered 403; App\Sesame\UserResolver now implements SESAME's RefreshesUser and looks the user up again on each request (a user deleted elsewhere is signed out). Script-side route() calls threw "route is not defined" since the route list moved into the bundle; app.ts defines the global again.

  • Fixed: HELMET's environment ribbon is a polite status region, so it is no longer content outside every landmark (axe: region), and a link followed from the open phone drawer no longer leaves the ribbon inert.

  • Changed: the regen baseline records the front-end files that now differ from Sourdough's Tailwind-based Inertia template, until Sourdough's template takes the same WayneUI wiring.

  • Changed: the docs pages wear the front page's look: the same header and main menu (Docs marked current), each page a cream sheet on the green field, commands on the quick start's terminal with its gold Copy button, the weld bead under every title, branded callouts and a derived dark mode. Motion only for readers who allow it. Sources: docs/_header.html, docs/theme/weld.css, the theme key in docs/docs.json.

  • Fixed: code on the front page's Sourdough card is cream, so it meets AA contrast on the deep green.

  • Changed: the front page header has a main nav that includes Docs.

  • Changed: the test APP_KEY is an obvious dummy (32 zero bytes), labeled test-only, and App\Support\DummyAppKey makes the app refuse it when APP_ENV=production; tests cover both.

  • Changed: the regen gate treats Squire kit files that WELD keeps under deploy/ as relocated (not drift), and oracle:check finds the check file at the app root or under deploy/.

  • Changed: WELD adopts Pest 4 for new tests: the PHPUnit class tests run unchanged, composer test runs Pest over the whole suite, tests/Pest.php is configured, the example feature test is converted, and pestphp/pest is required at ^4 because Pest 5 needs PHP 8.4.

  • Changed: CI pins the Preflight components to the 0.1.4 release SHA, so PROCTOR's preflight-pinned check passes.

  • Changed: the GitHub Actions in WELD's CI (actions/checkout, shivammathur/setup-php) are pinned to commit SHAs with the tag in a comment, so PROCTOR's ci-pipelines-unpinned-uses warning is gone; setup-php moves from the unpublished @v3 to 2.40.0.

  • Added: a docs site (site/docs/) built by the shared docs builder from docs/, checked in composer ci.

  • Changed: the regeneration baseline shrinks from 66 to 62 known-drift paths now that Sourdough no longer ships resources/js/app.js, welcome.blade.php or a phantom vite.config.js, and the .editorconfig matches.

  • Fixed: npm run lint passes on the shipped code: the dead badgeDir constant leaves scripts/readme-art/build.mjs, and Squire's kit bytes (site/assets/agent-ready.js, site/assets/stack-env.js, with the unused catch (e) bindings and dead variables fixed in Squire's kit) are synced in, so the ESLint config no longer excludes them.

  • Changed: npm run lint is now a pure check (eslint .); a new npm run fix script runs eslint . --fix.

  • Fixed: TrustedProxiesTest no longer depends on a local .env file. The trustProxies() closure in bootstrap/app.php runs when the HTTP kernel resolves on the first request, after the test's app refresh has re-read .env into the process environment, so the .env that composer create-project writes clobbered the value the test set and one of the four tests failed. The helper now re-asserts TRUSTED_PROXIES after the refresh, so the suite is green with a .env present and without one.

  • Changed: the README and front page say Sourdough bakes four shapes today (raw PHP, Laravel with Blade, Laravel with Blade plus Vue islands, and Laravel with Inertia and Vue) and only raw PHP with a Vue SPA is not available yet; the front page gains a card for the islands shape. WELD is the Inertia and Vue shape, already assembled with every part wired.

  • Changed: the front-page deploy layer pins HELMET ^0.3, PROCTOR ^0.4 and CREED ^0.1 (lock: HELMET 0.3.0, PROCTOR 0.4.0, CREED 0.1.6).

  • Changed: CI pins Preflight 0.1.4 (GitLab component includes and the GitHub reusable workflow at its tag commit); the deploy layer sets minimum-stability to stable.

  • Changed: HELMET moves to ^0.3 and PROCTOR to ^0.4 (lock: HELMET 0.3.0, PROCTOR 0.4.x, CREED 0.1.6, ADVISOR 0.1.5), so the newest PROCTOR checks run on WELD itself; an empty HELMET_PROXIES= now trusts nobody. Tests, style, analysis and PROCTOR pass unchanged.

0.1.2 (2026-11-03)#

  • Changed: SESAME moves from 0.2 to 0.4 (^0.4). It now logs sign-in events (sesame.login, sesame.logout, with a per sign-in session_ref; turn off with SESAME_LOG=false), re-reads the signed-in user when the resolver asks for it, and the gateway driver refuses an at+jwt access token. WELD itself needed no code change.
  • Fixed: the user menu gains a Sign out item on SESAME's logout route, the app bar branding drops the Laravel Starter Kit name and links (WELD logo text, waynestate/weld repository, weld.apps.wayne.edu documentation), .editorconfig covers compose.yaml and its variants, ExampleTest stops booting the framework, and UiBrandingTest pins the branding.
  • Changed: docs and package metadata name nougat as the canonical repository, with git.wayne.edu and GitHub as read-only mirrors, until git.wayne.edu has CI runners.
  • Changed: Laravel's trusted proxy list now comes from the TRUSTED_PROXIES environment variable (unset keeps Citadel's 172.18.0.1, set but empty trusts none, * trusts all), instead of a literal address. Citadel behaviour is unchanged.
  • Changed: the README and front page now say Sourdough is the starter tool for every shape of Wayne State app (raw PHP and Laravel with Blade today, the Vue shapes planned) and WELD is the Inertia and Vue shape, already assembled and ready to clone.
  • Changed: CI pulls its Docker Hub images through the GitLab Dependency Proxy (the group's CI_DEPENDENCY_PROXY_GROUP_IMAGE_PREFIX), so pipelines no longer hit Docker Hub's anonymous pull limit.
  • Added: waynestate/advisor joins require-dev at ^0.1, and "Clone it and rename" gains one step: php vendor/bin/advisor install --client=claude --write writes .mcp.json, which is now git-ignored because a committed MCP config would run a program on whoever opens the project. Set ADVISOR_ENABLED=1 in .env to switch the advisor on.
  • Changed: bin/weld.ps1 up and bin/weld.sh up write .mcp.json from ADVISOR inside the app container as part of the first-run setup (no PHP on the host PATH in the Docker path), with a --no-advisor opt-out on both scripts (-NoAdvisor on the PowerShell one).
  • Changed: the deploy layer's Squire kit is refreshed to 0.3.3 (release options can now live in ./.env.squire).
  • Changed: the deploy layer's Squire kit is refreshed to 0.3.4 (the local .env.squire file is now git-ignored).
  • Changed: the deploy layer's Squire kit is refreshed to 0.4.0: deploy/oracle-check.php arrives, so php artisan oracle:check runs the real check, and release.sh runs it without failing the release.
  • Changed: the Oracle overlay docs name Squire's parity image, squire/oracle-parity:8.3.
  • Added: StackIntegrationTest pins HELMET's security headers on a signed-in dashboard, a 404 error page and /up; ProctorCheckTest runs PROCTOR against CREED's policy.json inside the test suite, which composer ci alone did not cover.
  • Added: README section "Clone it and rename": copy WELD, rename the composer name, APP_NAME, site title and git remote, regenerate the key and re-run the checks, for PowerShell and sh.
  • Changed: BEST_PRACTICES.md re-checked against the code on 2026-11-02: the Squire kit's Dockerfile, entrypoint and release script move W10, W12, W16 and W24 from Not yet to Documented, W8/W13/W22 sentences name the new deploy files, and the shifted line numbers in composer.json, .env.example and bootstrap/app.php are corrected.
  • Added: the regen gate, which makes "WELD is the prebuilt Inertia shape" checkable: bin/regen-check.php compares a freshly generated Sourdough Inertia app (its .sourdough/manifest.json, path to SHA-256) with WELD file by file, skipping .sourdough/product-files.json entries and any vendor or node_modules path, and fails only on drift not already recorded in .sourdough/regen-baseline.json (a ratchet; --write-baseline records the current drift). The logic lives in App\Support\RegenCheck with unit tests, composer regen-check passes arguments through (not part of ci), and warning-only regen-gate jobs in both pipelines generate a fresh app from Sourdough's main and run the gate.

0.1.1 (2026-10-29)#

  • Added: agent-ready site (prompt blocks, Markdown twins, llms.txt), from Squire's kit.
  • Fixed: stale capability claims in the site and docs.
  • Changed: project names written as words except acronyms.
  • npm run typecheck (vue-tsc, no emit) joins the scripts, and it passes: the ten errors from the first run are fixed in the bullets below.
  • site/assets/wayne-ui/marks/warrior-strong-reverse.svg comes back from the WayneUI static bundle; the CSS has pointed at it since the front page assets landed.
  • The tsconfig types array keeps vite/client and regains ./resources/js/types: the shared interfaces move from index.ts to index.d.ts, which is the shape that entry resolves to. vue/tsx stays out, because it never resolved.
  • VITE_APP_NAME is declared in a new resources/js/env.d.ts against vite/client's ImportMetaEnv, replacing the inline declare module block in the app entry.
  • The app entry imports the Ziggy config from a new ziggy-value.js beside the generated ziggy.js, with a matching ziggy-value.d.ts: the generated declaration names the routes but not the value, and the value's string location predates the package's typed shape, so the declaration stops at the config minus that field.
  • SharedData extends Inertia's PageProps, so it satisfies the constraint usePage puts on its type argument.
  • AppHeader types its page with usePage<SharedData>(), so the user menu meets a User instead of unknown.
  • TextLink's optional method prop takes Inertia's Method union instead of string.
  • Welcome reads the signed-in state from usePage<SharedData>() instead of $page, which vue-tsc does not recognize on the component instance.

0.1.0 (2026-10-29)#

  • waynestate/helmet moves from ^0.1 to ^0.2 (locked at 0.2.3). The published config/helmet.php re-syncs with the package: HELMET_PRESET fills the proxy list (an unknown name throws at boot), and the security headers middleware joins the global chain, so every response carries the baseline. The trusted-header set narrows to X-Forwarded-For and X-Forwarded-Proto; X-Forwarded-Port is no longer trusted, because Citadel's HA-Proxy never sends it.
  • php artisan weld:doctor: local setup only: the app key, writable storage, the database and pending migrations. The standards checks (PHP version, debug in production, secure session cookies) belong to PROCTOR, and the report points at composer proctor.
  • Ziggy's route list leaves the inline <script> from @routes and moves into the Vite bundle: composer ziggy generates resources/js/ziggy.js (plus ziggy.d.ts), the app entry imports it and passes it to ZiggyVue, so route() works in Vue exactly as before while HELMET's strict CSP stays closed. A CI job regenerates the file and fails on any diff, and a feature test pins the contract that every script tag on the app page carries a nonce.
  • PROCTOR is welded in from Packagist (waynestate/proctor dev dependency, CREED's policy.json carried by waynestate/creed): composer proctor measures WELD against the version policy, and a CI job runs it on every pipeline. Warnings pass, failures block. The package's own bin looks for its autoloader where only a project-root install puts one, so composer proctor runs directly without a temporary launcher.
  • SESAME is welded in from Packagist (waynestate/sesame): sign-in moves from the starter kit's password forms to /login and /logout, owned by the package. The fake driver signs in locally; pointing at CAS is an env change. A username column joins users, and App\Sesame\UserResolver imports the identity on first sign-in.
  • HELMET is welded in from Packagist (waynestate/helmet): security headers and CSP on every web response, a published config/helmet.php, trusted proxies in bootstrap/app.php, and the Vite build asks for the per-request nonce. /up stays Laravel's built-in health route. Every web response now wears the baseline.
  • docs/running-off-citadel.md: the off-Citadel contract: OpenShift, Coolify and plain Docker, with Citadel for comparison. Traffic and trusted proxies per platform, php://stderr logs, writable paths, non-root user, /up, and weld:doctor after every deploy. Same bead, four different tables.
  • README: one line under "Run it locally" linking the guide.
  • php artisan weld:doctor: checks the app is set up safely, one PASS, WARN or FAIL line per check (PHP version, app key, debug in production, secure session cookies, writable storage, database, pending migrations); exits 1 when anything FAILs, --json for machines. A good bead is a quiet one: all PASS and nothing to say.
  • bin/weld.ps1 and bin/weld.sh: a doctor subcommand runs it in the app container.
  • README: "Check your setup".
  • compose.yaml: the local stack: the app (PHP and Composer in one image) and Vite, on pinned images, SQLite per .env.example, ports bound to 127.0.0.1 only.
  • bin/weld.ps1 (Windows, PowerShell 5.1 and 7) and bin/weld.sh (Linux and macOS, POSIX sh): up, down, test and logs, the same subcommands on every OS.
  • README: "Run it locally" is now one command per OS.
